description.value: Training Day Cafe is a takeout-only cafe in Surrey's Clayton neighbourhood, operating out of a unit at 8645 160 Street. The sports-inflected name suggests an orientation toward active customers, and the cafe accepts both credit and debit cards. Vegetarian options are available, making it a practical refuel stop for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m. Total: 4 spaces.
